patch.objective: Resample a series to a coarser frequency and choose the aggregate
secondaryObjectives: Interpret group results correctly, including count versus size and missing keys

sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch: resample returns a Resampler that must then be aggregated (.sum(), .mean(), .ffill(), .asfreq() and others). The case is a Power BI measure, not pandas: the decision it teaches is choosing the aggregate when daily stock snapshots go to months. Summing a closing balance over days counts the same stock thirty times; the month's value is the last snapshot (in pandas, .last()), and it must be reconciled with the latest count.

sources.cite: Use DAX time intelligence functions in Power BI Desktop models: Additional time intelligence calculations, Microsoft Learn training (updated 2025-06-27)
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch 2026-11-16. Relevant text: 'When summarizing snapshot values (like inventory stock levels), you can summarize values across any dimension except date'; 'Adding daily snapshot balances together doesn't produce a meaningful result'; the LASTDATE pattern returns BLANK when no snapshot exists for the last date in filter context ('A recorded date might not exist because it hasn't yet happened'); LASTNONBLANK 'returns the last date that produces a non-BLANK result'. Both measure patterns in the case are the page's.
